graph.scope_note: Raw output tensors are compared, so a pass implies identical decoded plans under the same adapter; this is a graph-equivalence check, not an accuracy claim.

plan.scope_note: The runtime under test is driven through its own infer path; a pass means its plans match the reference graph's plans under the same adapter — structure (behaviour order, target ids, completion types) exactly, numbers within rtol/atol. It is a consistency check, not an accuracy claim.
